FAQ_PAGE.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ_PAGE.subheadline: Everything you need to know before your visit to our Antioch barbershop.
FAQ_PAGE.ctaBody: Book online or give us a call — we're happy to help.

FAQ.q: Do I need an appointment, or do you take walk-ins?
FAQ.a: Appointments are recommended and easiest to book online. Walk-ins are welcome when a chair is open — call ahead on busy days to check availability.

FAQ.q: How do I book an appointment?
FAQ.a: Book online anytime through our booking page, or reach us at (925) 209-5995.

FAQ.q: What forms of payment do you accept?
FAQ.a: We accept credit cards and cash.
Yes — we welcome clients of all ages in a clean, comfortable shop.

FAQ.q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
FAQ.a: Please reschedule or cancel at least 24 hours ahead when possible. Late cancellations or no-shows may affect future booking availability.

FAQ.q: Do you offer beard grooming and hot towel shaves?
FAQ.a: Yes — every Signature Haircut & Beard service includes a hot towel and precision beard work.

FAQ.q: Can I request a specific barber?
FAQ.a: Absolutely — choose your barber when you book online, or ask us for a recommendation.
